text:
In ancient Egypt, people used a tool called a reed pen to write. They would dip the end of the reed into ink and use it to create symbols on papyrus, which was a type of paper made from river plants.

Ancient Egypt is a fascinating part of history. The Egyptians built massive pyramids to serve as tombs for their pharaohs. A pharaoh was the ruler of Egypt, similar to a king or queen, and was considered very important. These huge stone structures were built to honor the pharaohs and help them in the afterlife.
